query:nearest_region_option_label.answer_hint: set "answer" to the selected option letter as a capital letter
query:nearest_region_option_label.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an object mapping "reference_point" to the [x0,y0,x1,y1] box around the black reference point and "selected_option_region" to the [x0,y0,x1,y1] box around the selected option region

query:density_extremum_region_label.answer_hint: set "answer" to the exact visible region label as a string
query:density_extremum_region_label.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an object mapping "answer_region" to the [x0,y0,x1,y1] box around the selected density region

query:reference_distance_extremum_label.answer_hint: set "answer" to the exact visible region label as a string
query:reference_distance_extremum_label.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an object mapping "reference_mark" to the [x0,y0,x1,y1] box around the reference mark and "answer_region" to the [x0,y0,x1,y1] box around the selected density region

query:density_threshold_region_count.answer_hint: set "answer" to the requested count as an integer
query:density_threshold_region_count.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array of [x0,y0,x1,y1] boxes around every region matching the density-level threshold

query:spread_extremum_region_label.answer_hint: set "answer" to the exact visible region label as a string
query:spread_extremum_region_label.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an object mapping "answer_region" to the [x0,y0,x1,y1] box around the selected footprint region
